title: Set sheafification and local bijections in larger universes
statement: For a category C with objects in Type u and morphisms in Type v and a Grothendieck topology J, sheafification of presheaves valued in Type (max u v w) inverts exactly the locally bijective morphisms [def-weil-pbc-sheafification, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

source.place: Tags 00WK (sections of sheafification) and 00WM (locally injective and surjective maps)

proof.text: Equality of two sections in one plus construction is witnessed on a common covering refinement. Thus its unit is locally injective; composition and the comparison of sheafification adjunctions give local injectivity of the sheafification unit.

source.place: Tags 00WK (sections of sheafification) and 00WM (locally injective and surjective maps)

proof.text: Take the subsheaf locally generated by the image of the unit. The universal property factors the identity of the sheafification through this subsheaf. Hence the subsheaf is everything and the unit is locally surjective. Apply Mathlib WEqualsLocallyBijective.mk′.
